title: Multifunctional hybrid materials based on transparent poly(methyl methacrylate) reinforced by lanthanoid hydroxo clusters

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: pentanuclear europium hydroxo cluster with di(4-allyloxy)benzoylmethanide

material_class.structural_family: square-based pyramidal pentanuclear lanthanoid hydroxo cluster

synthesis.procedure: Under aerobic conditions, 2 eq. of abzmH were dissolved in methanol (30 ml) with heating and stirring. 1 eq. of EuCl3·6H2O was added, the mixture was stirred for 15 min, then an excess of triethylamine (usually >10 eq.) was added. The solution was refluxed for 16 h. Solvent and excess triethylamine were removed under reduced pressure. The residue was triturated with toluene and filtered to remove triethylammonium chloride. The toluene solution was concentrated and the cluster precipitated by addition of hexane. Single crystals of the tetratoluene solvate were grown by vapour diffusion of hexane into a toluene solution. Yields are quoted versus EuCl3(H2O)6.
synthesis.time: stir 15 min after metal salt addition; reflux 16 h
synthesis.vessel_or_method: aerobic solution reflux; rotary evaporation; trituration/filtration; hexane precipitation; vapour diffusion crystallization
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: remove solvent and excess NEt3 under reduced pressure; triturate with toluene and filter off Et3NHCl; concentrate toluene solution and precipitate with hexane; crystals by hexane vapour diffusion into toluene

properties.summary: The Eu cluster shows typical red Eu(III) luminescence upon 420 nm excitation in solid state and solution, with the abzm− ligand acting as an antenna; the 5D0→7F2 band at 611 nm dominates (I(5D0→7F2)/I(5D0→7F1) ≈ 16). Variable-temperature susceptibility of the Eu cluster is more complex than Curie–Weiss behaviour of the Tb/Ho analogues, consistent with other Eu(III) compounds. Red emission is retained in cluster-crosslinked PMMA^Eu.

measurements.name: excitation wavelength
measurements.conditions: solid-state emission (Varian Cary Eclipse) and aerated 1e-4 M ethyl acetate solution (Hitachi F-7000); also PMMA^Eu at room temperature

measurements.name: 5D0→7F0 emission
measurements.conditions: broad forbidden transition; indicates inequivalent Eu3+ sites

measurements.name: variable-temperature magnetic susceptibility
measurements.conditions: 5–250 K, applied field 7.96 kA m−1, SQUID MPMS-7

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: pentanuclear terbium hydroxo cluster with di(4-allyloxy)benzoylmethanide

material_class.structural_family: square-based pyramidal pentanuclear lanthanoid hydroxo cluster

synthesis.procedure: Same general aerobic procedure as the Eu analogue: 2 eq. abzmH in methanol (30 ml) heated until dissolved; 1 eq. TbCl3·6H2O added; stir 15 min; excess triethylamine (usually >10 eq.) added; reflux 16 h. Work-up by removal of solvent/excess base, toluene trituration/filtration, concentration, and hexane precipitation. Crystals of the tetratoluene solvate by hexane vapour diffusion into toluene.
synthesis.time: stir 15 min after metal salt addition; reflux 16 h
synthesis.vessel_or_method: aerobic solution reflux; rotary evaporation; trituration/filtration; hexane precipitation; vapour diffusion crystallization
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: remove solvent and excess NEt3 under reduced pressure; triturate with toluene and filter off Et3NHCl; concentrate and precipitate with hexane; crystals by hexane vapour diffusion into toluene

properties.summary: No typical green Tb(III) emission is observed, attributed to inefficient antenna sensitisation (abzm− singlet at 23810 cm−1 vs Tb 5D4 at 20500 cm−1). Magnetically the cluster follows Curie–Weiss behaviour with μeff close to the isolated-ion value and antiferromagnetic ordering at low temperature (TN = 2.3 K).
